title: Reduced motion
description: Assistant UI respects **prefers-reduced-motion** for typewriter and motion-heavy affordances where implemented.
content:
Reduced motion

Assistant UI respects prefers-reduced-motion for typewriter and motion-heavy affordances where implemented.

What this is

If your OS enables prefers-reduced-motion, Oasis reduces non-essential animations (for example typewriter suggestion cycling) while keeping functionality.

How to use it

  • Toggle the OS setting in Accessibility to see the calmer UI.
  • Critical progress spinners still animate enough to be visible.
  • No per-Oasis toggle is required in most builds.

Notes and limits

Some third-party OS themes ignore reduced-motion; results vary.
